Summary: TC-RBAC-001 Admin cannot read GLOBEX evidence via UI search
Preconditions: Admin nw-admin on NORTHWIND. GLOBEX evidence EV-GLOBEX-A filename globex-seal-A.bin.
Steps: 1. Authenticate as nw-admin. | 2. Open evidence search. | 3. Search globex-seal-A.bin. | 4. Capture result list.
Expected Result: Zero results; no GLOBEX object IDs; no GLOBEX metadata.

Summary: TC-RBAC-002 Investigator download of assigned NORTHWIND original
Preconditions: Investigator nw-inv assigned to NW-1; EV-NW-1 healthy.
Steps: 1. Authenticate as nw-inv. | 2. Open case NW-1. | 3. Download original EV-NW-1. | 4. Record HTTP status and byte length.
Expected Result: HTTP 200; byte length matches ingest; object remains NORTHWIND.

Summary: TC-RBAC-003 Investigator API GET on GLOBEX UUID returns 404
Preconditions: GLOBEX UUID 11111111-aaaa-4bbb-8ccc-222222222222 exists. NORTHWIND Investigator nw-inv token valid.
Steps: 1. Obtain Bearer token for nw-inv. | 2. GET /api/v1/evidence/{GLOBEX-UUID}. | 3. Record status and body. | 4. Admin query NORTHWIND audit.
Expected Result: HTTP 404; no metadata in body; NORTHWIND audit outcome=deny.

Summary: TC-RBAC-004 Cross-tenant evidence UUID returns 404 for Read-only
Preconditions: Read-only nw-ro on NORTHWIND. Same GLOBEX UUID as TC-RBAC-003. Unknown UUID 99999999-ffff-4aaa-8bbb-000000000000.
Steps: 1. Authenticate as nw-ro; confirm JWT tenant and role. | 2. GET GLOBEX UUID. | 3. Record status and body. | 4. GET unknown UUID. | 5. Admin audit for both object IDs.
Expected Result: Both GET return 404; bodies do not distinguish existence; two deny audit rows; fail on 403 or 200.

Summary: TC-RBAC-005 Foreign UUID vs unknown UUID same 404 shape
Preconditions: NORTHWIND Investigator; GLOBEX existing UUID and random UUID.
Steps: 1. GET foreign existing UUID. | 2. GET random UUID. | 3. Diff status and JSON keys.
Expected Result: Both 404; same key set; no exists/tenant discriminator.

Summary: TC-RBAC-006 Read-only denied original download home tenant
Preconditions: nw-ro assigned to NW-1; EV-NW-1 exists.
Steps: 1. Authenticate as nw-ro. | 2. Request original download EV-NW-1. | 3. Record HTTP status. | 4. Check audit.
Expected Result: HTTP 403; no bytes; audit outcome=deny.

Summary: TC-RBAC-007 Investigator cannot self-assign Admin
Preconditions: nw-inv valid; role-admin API available.
Steps: 1. Authenticate as nw-inv. | 2. PUT/PATCH own role to Admin. | 3. Re-read /me role. | 4. Confirm audit.
Expected Result: HTTP 403; role remains Investigator; audit deny on role_change.

Summary: TC-RBAC-008 Revoked Investigator token cannot download
Preconditions: Capture nw-inv token before Admin revoke. EV-NW-1 exists.
Steps: 1. Capture Bearer token. | 2. Admin revokes Investigator. | 3. GET download with old token. | 4. Record status.
Expected Result: HTTP 401 or 403; no bytes; 200 is a fail.

Summary: TC-RBAC-009 Body tenant_id GLOBEX ignored for NORTHWIND token
Preconditions: API list/search that accepts JSON body.
Steps: 1. Authenticate as nw-inv. | 2. Call list with body tenant_id=GLOBEX. | 3. Inspect objects.
Expected Result: Only NORTHWIND objects or empty; no GLOBEX objects.

Summary: TC-RBAC-010 Reporter cannot open unassigned case
Preconditions: nw-rep assigned only to NW-1; NW-2 exists.
Steps: 1. Authenticate as nw-rep. | 2. GET case NW-2. | 3. Record status and body.
Expected Result: HTTP 403; no NW-2 notes; audit deny.

Summary: TC-INT-001 Valid ingest stores server SHA-256 and size
Preconditions: Investigator nw-inv; case NW-1; file sample-32.bin exactly 32 bytes.
Steps: 1. Authenticate as nw-inv. | 2. Upload sample-32.bin Content-Length 32. | 3. Read stored hash and size. | 4. Download and hash locally.
Expected Result: HTTP 201; size 32; stored SHA-256 equals downloaded bytes.

Summary: TC-INT-002 Client server hash mismatch rejected
Preconditions: nw-inv; 32-byte file; client_sha256 fictional bbbb… that does not match bytes.
Steps: 1. Authenticate as nw-inv. | 2. POST ingest with mismatched client hash. | 3. Record HTTP status. | 4. Search for new evidence. | 5. Admin confirm no accepted custody with fake hash.
Expected Result: HTTP 400 or 422; no new object; 201 is a fail.

Summary: TC-INT-003 Truncated body vs Content-Length rejected
Preconditions: API client can send Content-Length 100 and only 40 bytes.
Steps: 1. Authenticate as nw-inv. | 2. POST ingest Content-Length 100 body 40 bytes. | 3. Record status. | 4. List evidence after T0.
Expected Result: No 201; zero new objects; fail if 40-byte object stored as complete.

Summary: TC-INT-004 Zero-byte upload rejected
Preconditions: Investigator upload API.
Steps: 1. Upload empty file Content-Length 0. | 2. Record status and list.
Expected Result: Reject 400/422; no object.

Summary: TC-INT-005 Custody event on ingest download export
Preconditions: Object EV-NW-INT-1 from TC-INT-001 present.
Steps: 1. Read custody after ingest. | 2. Download as nw-inv. | 3. Admin export including object. | 4. Read custody chain.
Expected Result: Ingest download export events; hash matches stored; UTC monotonic.

Summary: TC-INT-006 Evidence bytes immutable replacement is new object
Preconditions: EV-NW-INT-1 exists.
Steps: 1. Record hash of EV-NW-INT-1. | 2. Upload different file to NW-1. | 3. GET original bytes and hash.
Expected Result: Original hash unchanged; new object id for second file.

Summary: TC-AUD-001 Successful download is audited allow
Preconditions: Authorised download of EV-NW-1 as nw-inv completed.
Steps: 1. Perform authorised download. | 2. Admin query audit by object and time. | 3. Open newest download event.
Expected Result: Event actor tenant object action outcome=allow timestamp UTC.

Summary: TC-AUD-002 Denied cross-tenant GET is audited
Preconditions: After TC-RBAC-004 GET of GLOBEX UUID as nw-ro.
Steps: 1. Repeat GET if needed. | 2. NORTHWIND Admin filter audit. | 3. Confirm GLOBEX has no allow for this actor.
Expected Result: NORTHWIND outcome=deny; GLOBEX no allow; fail if deny missing.

Summary: TC-AUD-003 Home-tenant wrong-role 403 is audited
Preconditions: Pair with TC-RBAC-006 Read-only download.
Steps: 1. Trigger 403 download as nw-ro. | 2. Admin query audit.
Expected Result: outcome=deny action=download; fail if deny missing.

Summary: TC-AUD-004 Admin cannot delete an audit event
Preconditions: Known audit event id from TC-AUD-001.
Steps: 1. As nw-admin DELETE and PATCH audit event. | 2. Re-GET the event.
Expected Result: 403 404 or 405; event unchanged; fail on 204 delete.

Expected Result: Package contains only NORTHWIND objects; hashes present; no GLOBEX IDs.

Summary: TC-EXP-002 Reporter export assigned case only notes residual
